summary_1line: After Yudhishthira loses Draupadi in the dice game, she is dragged into the Kuru assembly, debates her status, is humiliated, and miraculously protected from disrobing.

image_candidates.scene_text: Dussasana drags a disheveled Draupadi by her long dark hair into the royal assembly while the elders sit silent and the Pandavas watch in rage.
Dussasana pulls at Draupadi’s robe as endless layers of cloth miraculously appear, piling on the floor while the stunned court watches.
Bhima stands trembling with fury in the court, fists clenched, swearing to tear open Dussasana’s chest and drink his blood.
